name: Length
summary: A flagship hair salon where the hair is the only colour on the page. The first screen is one photograph of the salon, edge to edge, with a client's long hair cut at the length you tap: a fine line glides to the mark and the hair below it fades softly in place (only the hair, a hand-cut layer of the same photograph), the price rides the cut line on a tag, and chairs free today sits on the chair back. Then every texture side by side, the stylists by their work, and the colour year. Ivory and ink; the one accent is rosemary, the hair-oil herb, only on the cut line, the chosen length and links. Darker Grotesque, light and very large, for the salon's voice and the price; Public Sans for everything else. A tape-measure rule opens the footer. Square edges; motion only when you cut. For hair salons and colourists.
